sources.title: Visa Regulations for Palestinian Passports as of 2026
sources.publisher: State of Palestine Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates, Protocol
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry's official mofa.pna.ps domain publishes this Protocol document specifically for Palestinian passports and labels it as current for 2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: VISA REGULATIONS FOR PALESTINIAN PASSPORTS AS OF 2026

sources.title: Current traveller visa and entry guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Côte d’Ivoire
sources.officialityEvidence: The live traveller guidance is published by Côte d’Ivoire's Foreign Ministry on its official diplomatie.gouv.ci domain and directs travellers to the recognised visa process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passeport valide plus de 6 mois et visa requis; demande en ligne via Snedai ou visa aéroportuaire sous conditions.

sources.title: Suspension of Visa Issuance to Foreign Nationals to Protect the Security of the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Department of State notice, last updated 2 February 2026, implements Presidential Proclamation 10998 and describes its current visa-issuance effect.
sources.supportingExcerpt: fully suspended visa issuance to individuals traveling on any travel documents issued or endorsed by the Palestinian Authority

sources.title: Presidential Proclamation 10998: Restricting and Limiting Entry
sources.officialityEvidence: The White House's live proclamation is the operative executive instrument. It fully suspends entry on PA-issued or endorsed documents while retaining listed exceptions and discretionary waivers.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The entry into the United States ... on any travel documents issued or endorsed by the PA ... is hereby fully suspended.

sources.title: 8 U.S.C. 1101: Immigration and Nationality Act definitions
sources.officialityEvidence: GovInfo publishes the official United States Code. The INA geographic definition establishes the territorial reach for U.S. immigration treatment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

sources.title: Entry visas
sources.officialityEvidence: Oman's current Foreign Ministry visitor page enumerates its exemption groups and directs other nationalities to the Royal Oman Police eligibility service, rather than publishing a Palestinian-passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of other nationalities can establish their visa options via the ROP’s eVisa website.

sources.title: Israel Entry country and passport-type data
sources.officialityEvidence: The live dataset is served by the Population and Immigration Authority's official Israel-entry portal. Its Palestine Authority row is separately labelled and flagged as not a passport country.

sources.title: Statute Governing the Issuance of ROC Visas in Foreign Passports
sources.publisher: Bureau of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: BOCA publishes the current foreign-passport visa statute on its official government domain. It permits refusal where a passport or foreign status is not recognized, without deciding Palestinian ordinary-passport acceptance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: is in possession of a foreign passport that is not recognized by the ROC government
